name: ultra-goal
description: Interview an objective into a grounded goal, emit the runnable artifact, and gate the run on its anchor. On Kimi the Stop gate is tagged --host kimi because this host triggers a blocking Stop at most once per turn, and UserPromptSubmit is the recovery channel: Kimi's reference makes every event but PreToolUse, Stop and UserPromptSubmit observation-only, so SessionStart is not registered here at all - a registration whose return value the host ignores would read as context recovery that cannot happen - and the injection other hosts get on session start arrives instead as one fixed-size line per prompt carrying the artifact pointer and the gate's last decision. A declared degradation, not parity.
